name: Socialism with Chinese characteristics
summary: Socialism with Chinese characteristics is the Chinese Communist Party’s official doctrine since Deng Xiaoping: China is in the primary stage of socialism, so it keeps public ownership as the mainstay alongside a socialist market economy, opens to foreign investment, and puts the Party in overall leadership of the state, the army and society. Its constitutions pair a people’s democratic dictatorship led by the working class with people’s congresses, regional ethnic autonomy and One Country, Two Systems, and reject Western separation of powers.
scope: The doctrine as the Party and PRC constitutions state it (the Article 1 formula of the PRC Constitution; the Party Constitution’s General Program), Deng Xiaoping’s founding speeches of 1979 and 1992, the 2021 Resolution on the Party’s history and the 20th Congress report, as the scholarship of Miller, Goodman and the ASAA brief places them. It excludes Mao Zedong Thought as a separate doctrine and other countries’ socialisms.
